title: N-linked glycan m/z candidate detection in mass spectrometry imaging
author: Jonas Cordes
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bvq5n5y6

steps.title: Configure Data View Signal Processing
steps.instruction: Open the Data view (Window > Show View > Data) and configure the Imaging tab settings.

substeps.instruction: Enable Savitzky-Golay smoothing with a half-window-size of 10
Enable TopHat baseline correction with a half-window-size of 50

steps.title: Load and Visualize Datasets
steps.instruction: Import the required imzML files and arrange the display.

substeps.instruction: Load files png1-no_normalization.imzML, png2-no_normalization.imzML, and control-no_normalization.imzML via File > Open File or Ctrl + O
Open the Options tab in the Data view, select 'Tile images with 1 row', and click Apply
Maximize the top view display using the blue square at the top right of the display menu

steps.title: Explore Dataset via Spectrum View
steps.instruction: Optionally create ion images and navigate the spectrum.

substeps.instruction: Create ion images by double-clicking any position in the value-area of the Spectrum view
Specify ion image tolerance in ppm or Da in the Create ion image property box in the Data view
Use Alt + Click&Drag and mouse wheel interactions for x-axis, y-axis, or isotropic zooming

steps.title: Perform Peak Picking
steps.instruction: Open the Peak Picking view (Window > Show View > Peak Picking) and configure the detection parameters.

substeps.instruction: Set Overview spectrum type Skyline to Mean
Click the Start peak picking button to apply to each dataset

steps.title: Combine Images
steps.instruction: Open the Combine Images view (Window > Show View > Combine Images), select the images in the required order, and click Combine images.

steps.title: Configure imzML Export
steps.instruction: Open the imzML export view (Window > Show view > imzML export) and select 'Continuous Centroid' from the drop-down menu.

steps.title: Save Combined Results
steps.instruction: Export the final processed data using the Data Manager.

substeps.instruction: Open the Data Manager view (Window > Show view > Data Manager)
Right-click on the combined-result-node and click save
Select file-format type '*.imzML' in the Save File Dialog
Specify the name and target file location and save the file
